description: Standup reads your git commits and agent sessions and writes your end-of-day update, so you stop piecing the day together from memory.

ui.aboutDescription: What {site} reads, what it writes and who made it.
ui.notFoundBody: This page does not exist. The rest of the site is still here.
ui.aboutBody: {site} is a Claude Code plugin with two skills, eod-review for a day and eow-review for a week. Radu Ceuca built it to answer one question at the end of the day: what did I do.
ui.headline: Your standup, written from what you did today.
ui.lede: It reads today's git commits and your Claude Code, Codex and Grok sessions, then writes the update you would have pieced together from memory.
ui.installNote: Not published yet. This command works once the repository is public. It reads files on your own disk and uploads nothing.
ui.readsTitle: It reads the record of your day.
ui.readsBody: Commits from every branch of every repo you point it at become four to six things you can say out loud. Your agent sessions become the token count beside them.
ui.weekTitle: On Friday, ask for the week.
ui.weekBody: eow-review covers Monday to Sunday and shows the same commits day by day, so Monday's work is still there on Friday.
ui.numbersTitle: The cost is an estimate, and the report says so.
ui.numbersBody: Tokens are counted by folder, branch and day, so they include the work that led nowhere. Cost is worked out at API list prices. On a subscription you pay none of it per token.
ui.requirements: Needs Python 3.9 or later and git. Runs on macOS and Linux.
